native_replacement_checks.method: Each emitted positive n-version finding was parenthesized and replaced at its exact byte span inside a separately named copy of its complete owned function. Whole original/replacement functions were compared across finite-site values, boundary values, a contiguous small-input sweep and primitive extrema. These are bounded independent native observations, not exhaustive execution over 32/64-bit input types.
native_replacement_checks.cpp_type_category_check: __is_same(decltype((original)),decltype((candidate))) static_assert; both C++17 and C++20; UBSan and nonrecovering errors enabled.
native_replacement_checks.rust_type_check: Each candidate also compiled in a function returning its reported exact primitive result type. Rust2021 native runs used overflow-checks=yes and overflow-checks=no separately.
native_replacement_checks.distinct_count_note: The 73 C++ findings are tested separately in two language modes; the final 54 Rust findings are tested in two overflow modes. Counts are not presented as twice as many distinct suggestions.

admission_and_budget_checks.explicit_python: Exit 2 with unsupported advisory language before attempting nonexistent source or Clang paths; no report/instrumentation file was requested or emitted.
admission_and_budget_checks.work_owner: Rust original evaluation, shared candidate-generator evaluation_steps and every reparsed Rust candidate evaluation charge the same global search work owner. Finite-flow propagation has its own bounded owner. At a 1000-work ceiling, exhaustion is visible and incomplete comparisons are never accepted.
admission_and_budget_checks.transaction_boundary: Entire file item admission occurs before any function analysis. A late alias/import/attribute withholds all earlier parsed functions. Unsupported body syntax withholds the whole function; raw-string contents cannot become phantom fn/braces.
admission_and_budget_checks.reuse_scope: File/function syntax rejection, opacity, keyword/cast grammar, checked-overflow admission and explicit Python rejection were observed on the initial snapshot. The reviewed production delta changes only constant construction, leaving those gates unchanged. Both explicit work caps were rerun on the final snapshot.
